title: Anthropic's $80.7B loss: $72.4B of it is one paper line
description:
Anthropic's S-1 (filed Oct 26) shows an $80.7B net loss for H1 2026. $72.4B is a change in the fair value of convertible notes, derivatives and SAFEs; the operating loss was $693M. Not financial advice.
